description_en: Create an audio or video transcription task
kebab_example: aliyun tingwu create-file-trans --app-key JV1sRTisRMi0000 --trans-key trans_123 --audio-oss-bucket bucket --audio-oss-path 'dir1/dir2/filename_http://……/0.mp3' --audio-language cn --audio-role-num 2 --audio-output-enabled false --audio-output-oss-bucket bucket --audio-output-oss-path tingwu/dir/filename --video-output-enabled false --video-output-oss-bucket bucket --video-output-oss-path tingwu/dir/filename --trans-result-oss-bucket bucket --trans-result-oss-path tingwu/dir/filename --audio-segments-enabled false --tags '{"key":"example-string"}' --asr-params '{"vocabulary_id":"e2a9a9be3128417fb4d181ebfbe80000"}' --lab-params '{"key":"example-string"}' --ability-params '{"key":"example-string"}' --api-version 2022-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFileTrans

parameters.help_en: AppKey of the project created in the console
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en: Additional ASR transcription parameters, such as hotword vocabulary_id
parameters.help_zh: ASR转写的额外参数，如热词vocabulary_id
parameters.name: asr_params

parameters.help_en:
Language model used for audio transcription.
cn: Chinese.
en: English.
yue: Cantonese.
fspk: Mixed Chinese and English
parameters.help_zh:
音频转写使用的语言模型。
cn：中文。
en：英文。
yue：粤语。
fspk：中英文自由说
parameters.name: audio_language

parameters.help_en: OSS bucket where the audio file to be transcribed is stored
parameters.help_zh: 需要转写音频所在的OSS Bucket
parameters.name: audio_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: OSS file path of the audio to be transcribed, or a custom downloadable URL (http|https). If AudioOssBucket is not empty, provide the OSS file path (...../.mp3). If AudioOssBucket is empty, provide a custom downloadable URL (http\://……/.mp3)
parameters.help_zh: 需要转写音频所在的OSS文件路径或者自定义可下载文件地址（http|https）。如果AudioOssBucket非空，则需要赋值OSS文件路径（...../*.mp3）；如果AudioOssBucket为空，则需要赋值自定义可下载文件地址（http://……/*.mp3）
parameters.name: audio_oss_path

parameters.help_en: Enable MP3 audio transcoding. Default is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启mp3格式音频转码，默认是false
parameters.name: audio_output_enabled

parameters.help_en: OSS bucket where transcoded audio is stored when audio transcoding is enabled. Must match the OSS bucket configured for the project in the console
parameters.help_zh: 开启音频转码时，转码音频写入到的OSS Bucket，需要与管控台项目配置的OSS Bucket一致
parameters.name: audio_output_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: OSS file path where transcoded audio is stored when audio transcoding is enabled. The path must start with "tingwu/"
parameters.help_zh: 开启音频转码时，转码音频写入到的OSS文件路径，需要以"tingwu/"为前缀
parameters.name: audio_output_oss_path

parameters.help_en:
Enable speaker diarization. Note: Only effective for audio with a sample rate of 16 kHz or higher.
Not set: Speaker diarization is disabled.
0: Speaker diarization with an unspecified number of speakers.
2: Speaker diarization for exactly 2 speakers
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启说话人角色区分。注，只对16K及以上采样率生效。
不设置：不使用说话人角色区分。
0：说话人角色区分结果为不定人数。
2：说话人角色区分结果为2人
parameters.name: audio_role_num

parameters.help_en: Enable writing detected valid audio segments to output. Default is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启有效音频片断检测结果写入，默认是false
parameters.name: audio_segments_enabled

parameters.help_zh: 系统扩展：实验转写参数
parameters.name: lab_params

parameters.help_en: Custom task identifier. This value is returned unchanged in task queries or task completion callbacks
parameters.help_zh: 用户设置的任务标识，在任务查询或任务结束回调时会原样返回
parameters.name: trans_key

parameters.help_en: OSS bucket where transcription and intelligent extraction results are stored. Must match the OSS bucket configured for the project in the console
parameters.help_zh: 识别及智能提取结果写入到的OSS Bucket，需要与管控台项目配置的OSS Bucket一致
parameters.name: trans_result_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: OSS file path where transcription and intelligent extraction results are stored. The path must start with "tingwu/"
parameters.help_zh: 识别及智能提取结果写入到的OSS文件路径，需要以"tingwu/"为前缀
parameters.name: trans_result_oss_path

parameters.help_en: Enable video transcoding. Default is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启视频转码，默认是false
parameters.name: video_output_enabled

parameters.help_en: OSS bucket where transcoded video is stored when video transcoding is enabled. Must match the OSS bucket configured for the project in the console
parameters.help_zh: 开启视频转码时，转码视频写入到的OSS Bucket，需要与管控台项目配置的OSS Bucket一致
parameters.name: video_output_oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: OSS file path where transcoded video is stored when video transcoding is enabled. The path must start with "tingwu/"
parameters.help_zh: 开启视频转码时，转码视频写入到的OSS文件路径，需要以"tingwu/"为前缀
parameters.name: video_output_oss_path

TransKey.description_en: Task identifier set by the user when creating the task
TransKey.description_zh: 用户创建任务时设置的任务标识
TransKey.title_en: 用户创建任务时设置的任务标识。
TransKey.title_zh: 用户创建任务时设置的任务标识。
